title: BEACON CAP profile — IPAWS (transcribed from the published OASIS profile)
description: Selected by CAP_PROFILE=ipaws. Applied AFTER schemas/cap-v1.2.schema.json and BEFORE the AlertSink records anything (ADR-036 §1). Passing this rule set is a self-check, NOT a conformance certification and NOT authorisation: BEACON performs no live IPAWS origination (IPAWS_ENABLED=off, CAP_EMIT_MODE=draft — ADR-010, Art. XIII). It produces + validates documents for the authority that owns the dissemination path.
$comment: SOURCE OF EVERY RULE BELOW — transcribed, never invented (spec-delta §2): OASIS, 'Common Alerting Protocol, v. 1.2 USA Integrated Public Alert and Warning System Profile Version 1.0', Committee Specification 01, 13 October 2009, §2 (Tables 1 and 2). https://docs.oasis-open.org/emergency/cap/v1.2/ipaws-profile/v1.0/cap-v1.2-ipaws-profile-v1.0.html — Each rule carries the requirement text VERBATIM in its own $comment. Rules from the same source that are deliberately NOT enforced here are listed in x-transcribed-not-enforced below, with the reason, so the transcription is complete and the gap is visible rather than silent.

status.$comment: VERBATIM: "A value of 'Actual' SHALL be used for messages intended for dissemination to the public, including test messages intended for delivery to the public." Enforced as a constant because this rule set runs ONLY on the pre-emit path — i.e. only for documents that are, by definition, intended for dissemination. A Draft preview never reaches a profile gate.

code.$comment: VERBATIM: "Value SHALL include the string 'IPAWSv1.0' to indicate the Profile version in use." Supplied by configuration (CapOptions.code), never hardcoded by the mapper: BEACON must not assert a profile version it was not configured for.

expires.$comment: VERBATIM: "REQUIRED." (base CAP v1.2 makes <expires> optional; the profile does not.)

eventCode.$comment: VERBATIM: "Messages intended for EAS, CMAS and HazCollect dissemination MUST include one and only one instance of this with a <valueName> of 'SAME' and using a SAME-standard three-letter value." Enforced unconditionally because selecting CAP_PROFILE=ipaws is precisely the statement 'validate as if for IPAWS dissemination'. The three-letter form is enforced as a shape (^[A-Z]{3}$); the SAME code LIST itself is not reproduced here — BEACON does not ship a copy of a code table it cannot keep current, and an unknown-but-well-formed code is the authority's to reject.

area.$comment: VERBATIM: "At least one <area> block MUST be present."

allOf.$comment: VERBATIM: "All related messages that have not yet expired MUST be referenced for 'Update' and 'Cancel' messages." Restated here so the profile file reads standalone; schemas/cap-v1.2.schema.json already enforces the same conditional, and src/domain/alert.ts rejects a reference-less UPDATE/CANCEL earlier still, at authoring time. BEACON cannot verify the 'all ... that have not yet expired' part — it references the alert being superseded, which is what buildFollowUpAlert guarantees; completeness across a longer chain is the operator's, and is recorded as a limitation.

x-transcribed-not-enforced.verbatim: Messages intended for EAS and/or HazCollect dissemination MUST include an instance of <parameter> with a <valueName> of 'EAS-ORG' with a <value> of the originator's 'SAME organization code.'
x-transcribed-not-enforced.reason: Conditional on EAS/HazCollect dissemination specifically. BEACON has no EAS or HazCollect path and is not an originating organization with a SAME organization code, so requiring the element would force operators to fabricate one. CapOptions.parameter carries it when a real originator supplies it.

x-transcribed-not-enforced.verbatim: A value of 'EAS Broadcast Content' SHALL be used to indicate elements intended for EAS broadcast. A mimeType of 'audio/x-ipaws-audio', 'audio/x-ipaws-streaming-audio', 'video/x-ipaws-video' and 'video/x-ipaws-streaming-video' SHALL be used to identify broadcast content.
x-transcribed-not-enforced.reason: Applies to CAP <resource> blocks. BEACON emits no <resource> block at all (no broadcast media is produced), so there is nothing to constrain.

x-transcribed-not-enforced.verbatim: At least one <geocode> with a <valueName> of 'SAME' and a six-digit SAME location value SHOULD be present.
x-transcribed-not-enforced.reason: A SHOULD, not a MUST. Enforcing it would turn a recommendation into a blocker for non-US regions. CapOptions.geocode writes it into every <area> block when configured.

x-transcribed-not-enforced.verbatim: All <info> blocks in a single alert MUST relate to a single incident or update, with the same <category> and <eventCode> values.
x-transcribed-not-enforced.reason: Not expressible in JSON Schema (it constrains array items relative to each other). Enforced in CODE and blocking on the same pre-emit path: capMachineValuesAgree() in src/adapters/interop/cap-mapper.ts compares category, eventCode, responseType, urgency, severity, certainty, web, parameter and area across every <info> block and fails the emission if any differ.

x-transcribed-not-enforced.verbatim: Ignored if present. Alerts SHALL be effective upon issuance.
x-transcribed-not-enforced.reason: A receiver-behaviour statement, not a document constraint. BEACON emits neither element, so there is nothing to validate.
